response.justification: While Bogdan is an excellent senior engineer with strong software craftsmanship practices and proven ability to architect complex systems, he lacks the required technical depth in Java and Kotlin. Most critically, he has no experience with IDE internals, language tooling, Spring ecosystem, or enterprise frameworks—all core to this role. His most recent substantial Java work was 8-12 years ago, and his career has shifted primarily toward TypeScript/Node.js/React, suggesting significant domain misalignment.
strengths: Senior-level engineer with proven track record architecting and leading complex distributed systems
Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, pair programming, and architectural rigor
Excellent communication skills demonstrated through multiple technical talks, workshops, and open-source community contributions
concerns: Severely limited and outdated Java experience (8-12 years since last meaningful Java work); no Kotlin experience mentioned
No background in IDE internals, language tooling, Spring ecosystem, or enterprise frameworks—all core technical requirements
Recent career trajectory focused on TypeScript/Node.js/React/AI infrastructure rather than JVM technologies, indicating potential misalignment

key_factors.factor: Missing IDE/tooling and Spring ecosystem expertise
Senior engineering level and strong architectural thinking
Outdated Java skills and recent non-JVM focus
